notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK checks for the official IEEE 1516.1 Advisories Use Known Class policy as it affects inherited attribute-relevance advisories. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, enabled or disabled known-class FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. The paired scenarios prove receiver-local discovery at the known base class, initial and final update advisories limited to the known attribute when the policy is enabled, and subscription-driven derived-only turn-up/turn-down advisories when the policy is disabled. They do not infer provider-specific class names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador Advisories Use Known Class and attribute-relevance declaration services with FederateAmbassador discovery and update advisories
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador known-class switch and FederateAmbassador attribute-relevance callback declarations
